registration_precedent.precedent: threshold-free B6-PATH concepts were registered as reserved semantic concepts with zero market-data read, zero runtime Job and zero parameter search; runtime qualification remained separately gated

short_term_trader.support: E7 preserves the complete failed-resolution path organization instead of reducing it to escape count or a Stage0 threshold. Stable reserved naming makes the neutral observable reusable across consumers.
short_term_trader.counterexample: One escape, repeated same-side escapes and alternating resolved escapes remain semantically distinct inside the structured measurement payload.
short_term_trader.veto: Registration must not create a binary disorder rule, a Stage label or independent descriptor Facts.

fund_manager.support: The observation is neutral Structure geometry under the existing B6-PATH owner. Stable semantic identity is useful even before economic or market qualification.
fund_manager.counterexample: Reserved naming must not imply that 20/10 is economically optimal or that the trace predicts reversal, accumulation or distribution.
fund_manager.veto: Do not turn reserved registration into runtime binding, strategy consumption or a new peer Stage.

quant_researcher.support: E5/E7 establish deterministic synthetic behavior, exact parity, scale invariance, PIT/reset semantics, structured value-digest compatibility and an existing Catalog result kind without adding a new type.
quant_researcher.counterexample: Synthetic representation conformance does not establish market separability, window optimality, predictive value or threshold validity.
quant_researcher.veto: Registration must preserve the current claim ceiling and must not open fresh search, parameter selection or qualification claims.

data_and_evidence_governance.support: The concept now has a stable three-segment identity, owned structure.geometry namespace, valid measurement result kind, exact EvaluationSpec/identity semantics, fail-closed availability behavior and explicit claim limits. Reserved registration is naming/boundary authority only.
data_and_evidence_governance.counterexample: The active P008 B6-PATH v1 contract is historically frozen and should not be rewritten in place merely to register this additive extension.
data_and_evidence_governance.veto: Actual registration must be additive: semantic catalog plus reviewed business metadata and planning/blueprint evidence alignment, with no runtime binding or mutation of the frozen P008 contract digest.

rejected_routes.REVISE: E7 removed the only identified representation defect without changing semantics or algorithm, and all frozen representation checks pass.
rejected_routes.KEEP_RESEARCH_ONLY: The concept meaning, owner, result kind, identity and claim limits are stable enough for naming/boundary registration; indefinite unregistered status adds no governance benefit.
rejected_routes.PARK: The semantic hypothesis and synthetic qualification are non-degenerate, and no unresolved object-model blocker remains.

decision.registration_claim_ceiling: Reserved semantic naming/boundary registration only. No runtime accepted binding, market qualification, Stage qualification, threshold authority, predictive value, economic usefulness or strategy/trading authority follows.

next_phase.purpose: Perform the additive reserved semantic registration selected by E8, update reviewed Chinese business metadata and deterministic Catalog/planning evidence, and record the B6-PATH extension as registered-but-unqualified without mutating the frozen P008 family contract or creating runtime bindings.
